title: Food: word → definition
description: Match eight food words with their definitions.
instructions: Tap a word on the left, then tap its match on the right.

pairs.definition: a round fruit with red, green or yellow skin
a long curved fruit with a yellow skin
a long orange vegetable that grows underground
a food made from milk that can be soft or hard
a baked food made from flour, water and yeast
a bird kept for its meat and eggs
small white or brown grains that are cooked and eaten
a soft red fruit used in salads and sauces
